latest_release.body:
_Changes since v0.9.5-rc01_

## ✨ Highlights

### 1. Glass & Backdrop Rendering Performance (`miuix-glass`, `miuix-blur` & `miuix-material`)

- **Faster Glass Rendering**: Skipped redundant offscreen mask passes for rounded-rectangle glass shapes, cached `GlassShadow` offscreen (`13324a08`), and optimized `GlassShader` sampling and spiral offsets (`218b24ef`, `ff58eff4`).
- **Single-Pass `LayerBackdrop`**: Recorded default `LayerBackdrop` with `backgroundColor` in a single pass (`357914e5`) and reused the recorded content layer for `onDrawUnderlay` in `GlassTopAppBar` and `GlassBottomSheet` (`9423408e`).

### 2. New `GlassScrollableTabRow` & Dropdown Scroll Indicator (`miuix-glass` & `miuix-preference`)

- **`GlassScrollableTabRow`**: Added `GlassScrollableTabRow` and `GlassTabRowDefaults.MinTabWidth` (`04e9b818`).
- **Dropdown Scroll Indicator**: Added a non-interactive scroll indicator to dropdown popups (`588d029f`).

### 3. Popup Safe-Area Constraints & Progressive Blur Polish (`miuix-ui`, `miuix-glass` & `miuix-blur`)

- **Popup Safe-Area & Anchor Reveal**: Constrained popups and tooltips to window safe areas and aligned anchor reveal behavior (`f763b5aa`, [#500](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/500)).
- **Progressive Blur Polish**: Refined progressive blur transitions to eliminate scroll jitter, anchored `GlassTopAppBar` progressive blur to `bottomContent`, lowered `ProgressiveBlurRadius` to `32.dp` (`8d3d0bb4`), and reduced default `BandOverhang` to `10.dp` (`f633ad2c`).

---

## 📋 Full Changelog

### Features

- **miuix-glass**: Add `GlassScrollableTabRow` and `GlassTabRowDefaults.MinTabWidth` (`04e9b818`)
- **miuix-preference / miuix-glass**: Add non-interactive scroll indicator to dropdown popups (`588d029f`)

### Performance

- **miuix-glass / miuix-blur / miuix-material**: Skip redundant glass mask passes and cache `GlassShadow` offscreen (`13324a08`)
- **miuix-glass**: Optimize wide tint sampling and precompute Vogel spiral offsets in `GlassShader` (`218b24ef`, `ff58eff4`)
- **miuix-blur**: Record default `LayerBackdrop` with `backgroundColor` in a single pass (`357914e5`)
- **miuix-blur / miuix-glass**: Reuse recorded content layer for `LayerBackdrop` `onDrawUnderlay` in `GlassTopAppBar` and `GlassBottomSheet` (`9423408e`)

### Fixes

- **miuix-ui / miuix-glass / miuix-preference**: Constrain popups and tooltips to window safe area, align anchor reveal, and guard short viewports (`f763b5aa`, [#500](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/500))
- **miuix-glass**: Scale `GlassTransformPopup` close rebound with predictive back progress (`e556b713`)
- **miuix-blur / miuix-glass**: Refine progressive blur ramp and `GlassTopAppBar` `bottomContent` anchoring, and lower `ProgressiveBlurRadius` to `32.dp` (`8d3d0bb4`)
- **miuix-glass**: Reduce `GlassTopAppBar` default `BandOverhang` to `10.dp` (`f633ad2c`)
- **miuix-glass**: Eliminate seam in `GlassTopAppBar` non-progressive band (`e5338080`)
- **miuix-glass**: Default `GlassBottomSheet` `progressiveBlur` to `false` (`6aa83241`)

### Example & Documentation

- **example**: Add new icon for iOS ([#499](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/499))
- **example**: Add long-press icon name copy with Snackbar confirmation in `IconPage` and fix `SnackbarHost` insets (`bc1024d7`)
- **example / docs**: Add `GlassScrollableTabRow` examples in `GlassPage` and docs demo, and update docs (`04e9b818`)
- **example / docs**: Add `TopAppBar` `TabRow` count (`1–4`) selector in `GlassPage` and update docs (`8d3d0bb4`)

### Baseline Profiles

- **library / example**: Update baseline and startup profiles (`e636bd6c`)

### Dependencies & Build

- **build**: Update `com.android.tools.build:gradle` to `9.5.3` ([#498](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/498))

---
